definitions.explanation: A playing piece used in mahjong. A standard set contains 136 tiles divided into suits (萬子, 筒子, 索子) and honor tiles (字牌). Also written as 牌 in other tile-based games.

examples.japanese: {牌|ぱい}を{混|ま}ぜてから{配|くば}る。
examples.english: Shuffle the tiles and then deal them.

examples.japanese: {手|て}{牌|ぱい}の{中|なか}から{不要|ふよう}な{牌|ぱい}を{選|えら}んで{捨|す}てる。
examples.english: Choose an unnecessary tile from your hand and discard it.

notes: In mahjong terminology, {牌|ぱい} appears in many compounds: {手牌|てはい} (tiles in one's hand), {字牌|じはい}/つーぱい (honor tiles), {萬子|まんず}/{筒子|ぴんず}/{索子|そーず} (the three number suits). Key verbs used with tiles: {牌|ぱい}を{切|き}る (to discard), {牌|ぱい}を{引|ひ}く (to draw), {牌|ぱい}を{鳴|な}く (to call a discarded tile). Mahjong is extremely popular in Japan both as a social game and as a subject of manga and anime.
